prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME] for the client, [LOSS_DATE] for the accident date and [DEMAND_AMOUNT] for the money demanded. Say an expert review supports a permanent injury and give the insurer 30 days to pay. No other names or dates.
text:
Dear Claims Representative:

This office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The facts of the collision establish that your insured's negligence caused the crash. Our client was stopped at a traffic signal when your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's car at a high rate of speed. Police documentation and photographs of the damage corroborate this account.

As a result of the impact, our client suffered serious injuries to the neck and spine. Following extensive medical treatment, including imaging, physical therapy, and specialist consultation, our client's treating physicians have documented ongoing symptoms and functional limitations. An independent expert review has concluded that these injuries are permanent in nature and will require future medical care. Our client has also lost time from work and continues to experience pain that affects daily life.

Our client has been fully cooperative throughout the claims process. We have enclosed the medical records, billing statements, wage documentation, and the expert review supporting these conclusions.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to settle this claim in full. You have thirty (30) days from the date of this letter to tender payment. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.

Sincerely,

Attorney of Record
